articles.title: Satellite observations show how rain breaks up Earth's natural sunshades
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Delivering on its promise, the European Space Agency's EarthCARE satellite is already yielding new insights into the role that clouds play in regulating Earth's climate. The latest findings shed light on one of the processes that leads to the breakup of vast, bright cloud formations that help keep our planet cool—with rain emerging as a key driver.
